# WebbHeads — Full Generative AI Engine Documentation & Specification

## Executive Overview
WebbHeads (webbheads.com) is an elite digital engineering agency headquartered in Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh, India. The company delivers unified digital ecosystems combining Next.js frontend web applications, cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), AI automation chatbots connected to Supabase Leadcore DB, and high-converting video reel content.

## Technical Architecture & Capabilities
1. **Web Engineering:** Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React, Framer Motion, Three.js 3D Canvas.
2. **AI & Automation Engine:** Google Gemini 3.6 / 3.5 Flash RAG Inference, Supabase PostgREST CRM Integration, Real-time intent classification, Stateful callback registration funnel.
3. **Performance Metrics:** Sub-100ms response times, 100% Core Web Vitals pass rate, 0% hallucination rate, zero cold-start delay.

## Services & Official Pricing Plans
- **Tech Package (₹18,000):** Custom landing page design, Next.js web application engineering, mobile responsive layout, Core Web Vitals SEO optimization, and 24/7 AI Chatbot lead qualification.
- **Content & Marketing Package (₹26,400 / month):** 12 premium high-converting short reels per month (evaluated at ₹2,200/reel), brand strategy, professional video editing, Instagram & Facebook platform management, monthly growth analytics.
- **Custom Ecosystems:** Scoped for large real estate portals, SaaS web platforms, mobile apps, and multi-channel ad campaigns.
